steps.body:
Manage soft-deleted vault files

Usage:
  symdesk trash [command]

Available Commands:
  list        List soft-deleted files
  purge       Permanently remove old items from the trash
  restore     Restore a soft-deleted file to its original location

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for trash

Global Flags:
      --json            output in JSON format
      --output string   output format: text|json|yaml (--json is shorthand for --output json)
      --vault string    override document vault path (the Markdown workspace; unrelated to symvault)

Use "symdesk trash [command] --help" for more information about a command.
